title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct final answer of approximately 25 interactions.

title: Use of Cross Section
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the given cross section value in their calculations.

title: Nucleon Calculation
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the number of nucleons encountered using the provided density and dimensions.

title: Correct Formula Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should use the correct formula for calculating the total number of interactions involving neutrinos.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or miscalculating the number of nucleons.
